title: SDDR-CF7 - EOCR shutdown auto restart relay (SDDR), 110/115/120 VAC
range_short_desc: Shutdown auto restart relay for momentary power failure (EOCR SDDR)
description: Schneider / Samwha EOCR SDDR-CF7 shutdown auto restart relay — 순간정전 재기동 계전기. It solves the problem of having to restart every motor on a line by hand after a process trips on a brief voltage dip. Two settings do the work: SDDT (shut down delay time) is how long an outage may last and still count as momentary, and DOMT (delay on make time) is how long the relay holds its contacts open after power returns before letting the motor restart, so a whole plant does not slam back on at once. An A/B selector matches the relay to whichever way the external sequence is wired, and a TEST button simulates an outage for preventive maintenance. Plugs into a standard 8-pin socket. The unit SAV stocks is the CF7, the analogue knob-set version on 110/115/120 VAC.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Shut Down Delay Time (SDDT) — power must return within the set SDDT for auto restart to trigger; if the outage runs longer, auto restart is inhibited and the operator restarts manually
Delay on Make Time (DOMT) — after power returns within SDDT, contacts are held open for the set DOMT and then closed, so restarts can be staggered across a line
A/B selection switch — set to match the wiring on the external sequence drawing, then press TEST to apply immediately
TEST button simulates a real outage for as long as it is held, for preventive maintenance checks

feature_groups.title: Typical applications
items: Continuously running conveyor systems and batch-processing chemical plants
Steel mill transfer equipment and textile factories
Other magnetic contactors driving special loads

specs.group: Nameplate of the stocked unit (photographed from SAV stock)
rows: Model : SDDR-CF7
Description : Shutdown Auto Restart Relay / 순간정전 재기동 계전기
Power supply : 110/115/120 VAC
Reference : K14323 — Made in South Korea, CE, Schneider Electric
Front panel : TEST button, A/B selector, DOMT knob (Off, 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30), SDDT knob (0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5), MON (red) and PWR (green) LEDs
Terminals : A1, A2, with ON/OFF positions marked for A and B
SDDT (shut down delay time) : 0.5 – 5 seconds
DOMT (delay on make time) : Off, 1 – 30 seconds
Control power : code 110 = AC 85–150 V, code 220 = AC 180–260 V
Frequency : 50/60 Hz
Auxiliary contact : 3 A / 250 VAC resistive load
Operation status display : 2 × 5 rectangular LED, green and red
Installation : 8-pin socket
Time of duration : 85 ms or over
Caution : heavy harmonics on the control supply can raise the recognition voltage, so allow for it in harmonic-rich installations
Power supplied : relay open
On switch input : relay closed
Momentary power outage : relay open
Outage longer than SDDT : relay open
DOMT timer running : relay open
Back to normal operation : relay closed
Recommended sockets : KH-KTS-8 (Koino), K2CF08 (KACON), PS-08 (MENICS)
Mounting : 35 mm DIN rail and screw mounting
Wiring options : 3-wire A type, 3-wire B type, 4-wire B type
Dimensions : 60 × 50 mm body, 56.6 mm socket, 15 mm depth behind the socket, 8 × Ø2.4 pin circle
SDDR operates normally once its internal capacitor has charged, about five seconds after power is applied
Temperature : operation -20 … 60 °C, storage -30 … 80 °C
Humidity : 30 – 85% RH, non-condensing
Insulation resistance : 10 MΩ or over at 500 VDC between case and circuit
Insulation withstand : 2 kV, 50/60 Hz, 1 min between case and circuit
ESD (IEC 61000-4-2) level 3 : air ±8 kV, contact ±6 kV
Radiated disturbance (IEC 61000-4-3) level 3 : 10 V/m, 80 MHz – 1 GHz and 1.4 – 2.7 GHz
EFT/burst (IEC 61000-4-4) level 3 : ±2 kV, 1 min
